dayPlan:
We'll enjoy a relaxed harbour cruise under the Bridge, head to Athol Bay for the beach, Opera House and skyline views, then berth at Darling Harbour for lunch — likely Nick's Seafood. We should be back at Drummoyne around 4pm.

Please bring a hat, sunscreen, a light jacket and comfortable soft-soled shoes. Lifejackets will be provided. If you're prone to seasickness, take your usual medication before arriving.

Weather permitting — I'll confirm everything on Friday.
